name: telnet
purpose: Connect to a remote host over a text-based TCP connection.
explanation: Demonstrated in C03 (`brew install telnet`, then `telnet towel.blinkenlights.nl`) to watch Simon Jansen's 1997 ASCII-art Star Wars animation over the internet.

parameters.description: Hostname or IP address to connect to.

explanationOfOutput: Opens a raw text stream to the remote server.
whenToUse: To connect to legacy text services or test TCP port connectivity.
commonMistakes: Using unencrypted telnet for sensitive logins (use SSH instead).
